title: How to use Claude Code with VS Code? (Best AI Coding Assistant?)
description:
Learn how to use Claude Code with VS Code to supercharge your development workflow. In this tutorial, I'll show you why using the official Anthropic plugin is better than the terminal alone, how to install it, and why using your Claude Pro subscription saves you money compared to expensive API tokens. We also cover 'Auto Mode' and the '/goal' command for maximum productivity.

Key Highlights:
- Installation guide for the official Claude Code plugin
- Managing sessions in VS Code tabs
- Saving money with Pro/Max subscriptions vs API pricing
- Using Auto Mode and Goal features
